# SOS Insurance

> SOS (the Sales Operating System) installs the Pipeline Power System inside employee benefits and commercial P&C agencies. Every producer gets a written target, a 14-touch outreach sequence and a follow-up cadence built in their own voice, so new doors open every week without the agency owner carrying the pipeline. Founded and led by Ryan James Miller.

## Who it is for

- Independent employee benefits advisors and commercial P&C producers with a $500K+ book (the Advisor Track).
- Benefits and commercial P&C agencies that want the system built and handed to their producers (the Agency Track).
- Agencies that want the system built and SOS staying in with coaching, leadership calls and accountability (the Scale Track).
- Not built for personal-lines-only agencies.

## The problem it solves

Most agencies win once a producer is in the room. The problem is too few doors opening. Growth depends on the founder's relationships and referrals, production runs feast or famine, and new producers are hired with nothing to hand them.

## The Pipeline Power System

- **The Target Lock:** the ideal account defined by size, industry, pain profile, fit signals and decision makers, plus the triggers that make now the time to reach out.
- **The 1440:** 14 touches over 40 days across 6 channels, timed to renewal dates and x-dates. Every message delivers value before it makes an ask.
- **The Value Cadence System (VCS):** keeps producers present from first conversation to closed deal.
- **The Force Multiplier:** AI prompts that help producers run the system faster, in their own voice.
- **The Personal Runbook:** every producer gets 27 scripts across the 1440 and Value Cadence plays, written in their voice, with their pipeline math worked out to conversations per week and hours per week. Every Runbook gets a red-flag review for claims the agency cannot stand behind.

## How an engagement runs

Done with you, over 6 to 12 weeks: four live build sessions (Kickoff and Diagnostic, Target Lock, the 1440, the Value Cadence System), then a Personal Runbook for every producer, then weekly forum calls and coaching support. Payment is a deposit with installments tied to build milestones.

## Results

- A regional benefits agency: over $1.5 million in closed business across 9 producers in the first seven months. One producer went from $75K to $100K a year to over $200K. Every producer generates at least one qualified new-business appointment a week.
- A VP of Sales at a benefits firm closed two deals worth $75K within 90 days of kickoff.

## Field guides

All guides: https://sos4insurance.com/guides/


- [How do benefits agencies prospect for new employer groups?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/how-benefits-agencies-prospect-for-new-employer-groups/): write the target down, qualify before the first touch, run a multi-channel sequence timed to the renewal date.
- [How do I get my producers to prospect without me?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/how-to-get-producers-to-prospect-without-the-owner/): a written target, scripts in each producer's voice, a weekly number and a weekly forum.
- [What is a good prospecting sequence for commercial insurance producers?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/prospecting-sequence-for-commercial-insurance-producers/): the 1440, touch by touch.
- [What Should Go in an Insurance Producer's Ideal Client Profile?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/ideal-client-profile-for-insurance-producers/): the Target Lock: size, industry, pain profile, fit signals, decision makers and triggers, turned into a pass/fail gate.
- [How Many Prospects Does a Producer Need to Hit Their New Business Goal?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/how-many-prospects-to-hit-new-business-goal/): pipeline math from the new business goal back to touches and hours a week.
- [How Should Insurance Producers Follow Up When a Prospect Says "Not Right Now"?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/follow-up-when-prospect-says-not-right-now/): the Value Cadence System: 7 value touches over 21 days, then re-engagement.
- [How Can Insurance Producers Use AI for Prospecting Without Sounding Like a Robot?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/ai-for-insurance-prospecting/): the Force Multiplier: use AI to refine a producer's own material, never to invent results.
- [How Do I Get a New Insurance Producer Prospecting Faster?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/how-to-ramp-a-new-insurance-producer/): hand a new producer a system in week one: target, sequence, scripts in their voice, a weekly number.
- [Is Sales Training Worth It for Insurance Agencies?](https://sos4insurance.com/guides/is-sales-training-worth-it-for-insurance-agencies/): why one-day workshops rarely change production, and what to ask before paying for training.
